description: Brazil Documento Unico Virtual provides quarterly counts of Documento Único Virtual port documents in Brazil's Porto Sem Papel system. The provider is Ministerio dos Transportes. Geographical and temporal coverage: The official portal lists port-level CSV releases through July 2026 and quarterly periodicity. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Public domain (dados.gov.br licence label: Outra (Domínio Público)). A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: These are document counts by port, not directly measured vessel dwell times or cargo tonnage. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
